comparison.objective: Infer an acceptance rule from a limit-sample board and sort four loose parts accordingly.
comparison.physical_skill: Visual rule induction, classification, and repeated bin sorting.
comparison.success_condition: Accepted parts in the green tray and rejected parts in the red tray; exact scoring tolerances are absent.
comparison.reason: The central ability is classification from examples, not force-controlled bimanual fracture and recovery of generated fragments.
